metadata.source: VaultX SIMULATED NVD CVE Subset for BECPL
metadata.description: Offline CVE catalog relevant to BECPL IT, Engineering, OT, DMZ, and Phase 1 vulnerable assets.

cves.title: SMBGhost - Windows 10 1909 SMBv3 Compression RCE
cves.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way Microsoft Server Message Block 3.1.1 (SMBv3) handles certain crafted compressed packets on Windows 10 version 1909.
cves.remediation: Apply KB4551762 or upgrade Windows 10 past build 1909; disable SMBv3 compression.

cves.title: OpenSSH 7.4 Untrusted Search Path in ssh-agent PKCS#11
cves.description: Untrusted search path vulnerability in ssh-agent.c in OpenSSH before 7.4p1 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary local PKCS#11 modules via forwarded agent sockets.
cves.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to >= 8.9p1 and restrict agent forwarding on engineering workstations.

cves.title: Flask 1.0 Improper Input Validation DoS / JSON Memory Exhaustion
cves.description: Pallets Project Flask before 0.12.3 / unpatched 1.0 dev builds contain improper input validation allowing denial of service via crafted JSON payloads with unexpected encoding.
cves.remediation: Upgrade Flask to >= 2.3.x and enforce strict request body limits at MES gateway.

cves.title: nginx 1.14 HTTP/2 Data Dribble Resource Exhaustion
cves.description: nginx 1.14 HTTP/2 implementation allows excessive CPU and memory usage via small window updates leading to denial of service on firmware storage web server.
cves.remediation: Upgrade nginx to >= 1.24.0 and enforce HTTP/2 rate limits.

cves.title: FortiOS SSL-VPN Heap Buffer Overflow
cves.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in FortiOS SSL-VPN allowing remote code execution via crafted requests.

cves.title: Jenkins CLI Arbitrary File Read
cves.description: Jenkins controller CLI parser expands @file arguments allowing unauthenticated file read.

cves.title: GitLab CE/EE Path Traversal
cves.description: Unauthenticated malicious user can read arbitrary files when attachment exists in nested public project.

cves.title: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 PLC Protection Bypass
cves.description: Industrial PLC protocol weakness permitting unauthorized state inspection or manipulation when network segmentation is absent.
cves.remediation: Isolate VLAN 30, enforce engineering allowlist, upgrade PLC firmware in planned downtime.

cves.title: Windows Print Spooler RCE (PrintNightmare)
cves.description: Windows Print Spooler improperly performs privileged file operations.
cves.remediation: Disable Print Spooler on servers and apply cumulative Windows security updates.

cves.title: Microsoft Outlook NTLM Credential Disclosure
cves.description: Crafted email or calendar reminder forces outbound SMB connection leaking Net-NTLMv2 hash.
cves.remediation: Patch Microsoft Office/Outlook and block outbound TCP/445 at perimeter firewall.
